one_liner_zh: Meta EPS超預期逾8%，廣告獲利能力延續強勢。
one_liner_en: Meta beats EPS by over 8% as ad profitability stays strong.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS驚喜+8.60%，營收598.9億美元規模龐大，獲利動能強。
ai_view_zh: 訊號正向：EPS超預期8.6%，獲利能力與成本紀律雙佳。短中期在廣告變現效率提升與合理估值支撐下，股價具韌性。市場關注重心將轉向資本支出強度與AI投資能否持續轉化為廣告營收成長。追蹤指標：營業利益率、資本支出年增、每用戶平均收入、AI功能採用率。若資本支出失控而回報遞延，恐壓抑市場情緒。
ai_view_en: Signal positive: EPS beat by 8.6% with strong profitability and cost discipline. Near to mid-term, improving ad monetization and a reasonable valuation give the stock resilience. Focus shifts to capex intensity and whether AI investment keeps translating into ad revenue growth. Track: operating margin, capex growth, ARPU, and AI feature adoption. Runaway capex with deferred returns could weigh on sentiment.
highlights_zh: EPS 8.88美元，大幅超出預期8.18美元，驚喜幅度8.60%。
單季營收598.9億美元，反映年末廣告旺季強勁。
AI推薦系統持續提升廣告投放效率與點擊率。
成本紀律與營運槓桿推升營業利益率。
本益比21.68倍，獲利成長下估值仍具吸引力。
highlights_en: EPS of $8.88 beat the $8.18 estimate by 8.60%.
Quarterly revenue of $59.89B reflects strong year-end ad seasonality.
AI recommendation systems keep improving ad efficiency and CTR.
Cost discipline and operating leverage lift operating margins.
P/E of 21.68 remains attractive given earnings growth.
risks_zh: AI與資料中心資本支出大增，須觀察回報週期。
Reality Labs虧損仍是獲利包袱。
廣告需求受總體景氣與隱私政策影響。
risks_en: Rising AI and data-center capex requires watching the payback cycle.
Reality Labs losses remain an earnings drag.
Ad demand is exposed to macro cycles and privacy policy changes.
